title: US undervalued quality research hypothesis — draft, not a model
status: TRACK B RESEARCH FOUNDATION — NOT A MODEL
weight_policy: No family weights are frozen and no outcome optimization is permitted in this milestone.
point_in_time_rule: A fact must have non-null public_at and retrieved_at timestamps no later than decision_at; later evidence is excluded, not imputed.

factors.name: free_cash_flow_yield
factors.rationale: Relates owner cash generation to the price paid.
factors.numerator: TTM operating cash flow minus TTM capital expenditure
factors.currency_unit: same currency; numerator and denominator monetary
factors.negative_treatment: retain signed value for research; withhold ranking
factors.denominator_guard: strictly positive and above configured materiality floor
factors.sector_limitations: financial companies require separate comparability review

factors.name: return_on_assets
factors.rationale: Measures earnings generated per unit of assets.
factors.negative_treatment: negative is valid but not converted to a score in this draft
factors.denominator_guard: positive average assets above materiality floor
factors.sector_limitations: industry balance sheets may not be comparable

factors.name: net_debt_to_operating_cash_flow
factors.rationale: Tests debt burden against internally generated cash.
factors.numerator: current debt plus non-current debt minus cash
factors.negative_treatment: net cash is retained; non-positive cash flow withholds ratio

factors.name: revenue_growth
factors.numerator: current TTM revenue minus prior TTM revenue
factors.currency_unit: same reporting currency and USD monetary unit

factors.name: diluted_share_growth
factors.rationale: Identifies dilution or contraction in owners' claim count.
factors.numerator: current diluted shares minus prior comparable diluted shares
factors.negative_treatment: buybacks may yield negative values; retain signed value

factors.name: total_return_volatility
factors.rationale: Describes variability of shareholder total returns.
factors.numerator: annualised standard deviation of split-adjusted daily total returns
factors.staleness: latest completed session within seven calendar days
factors.sector_limitations: none; security actions can make series incomparable
